name: Sachin Katti
moniker: OpenAI's Head of Compute and Former Stanford Networking Professor
quick_facts: Head of Compute at OpenAI, overseeing infrastructure for training and serving frontier models
Former tenured Associate Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at Stanford
Previously Chief Technology Officer of Intel's Network and Edge Group
Co-founded Kumu Networks, a wireless technology startup
hook: Katti built his career on the unglamorous but essential problem of moving data efficiently, first in academic networking research, then running Intel's networking hardware division, and now at OpenAI, where the physical compute infrastructure behind frontier AI models is his direct responsibility.

achievements.title: Tenured faculty, Stanford Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
achievements.impact: Built an influential academic research program in computer networking and wireless systems before moving to industry.

achievements.title: Co-founding Kumu Networks
achievements.impact: Commercialized full-duplex wireless technology developed from his Stanford research, later acquired by Alphabet's Tarana Wireless business.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, Intel Network and Edge Group
achievements.impact: Directed technology strategy for Intel's networking silicon and edge computing hardware business.

achievements.title: Head of Compute, OpenAI
achievements.impact: Oversees the infrastructure strategy behind training and deploying OpenAI's frontier AI models at massive scale.

timeline.impact: Builds an influential networking research program

timeline.event: Becomes CTO of Intel's Network and Edge Group
timeline.impact: Leads networking hardware strategy at Intel

timeline.event: Joins OpenAI as Head of Compute

quote.text: Compute is the substrate everything else in AI is built on; get the infrastructure wrong and nothing else matters.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Katti's public remarks on AI infrastructure strategy
